title: CCSDS LDPC Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/CCSDS_LDPC_Decoder.md
text: Decode LDPC code according to CCSDS standard, 5 inputs, 5 outputs; {Configuration type} sets the type of configuration, {Decoding termination criteria} sets the termination criteria, {Source for number of iterations} sets the source selection for number of iterations, {Number of iterations} sets the number of decoding iterations, {Maximum number of iterations} sets the maximum number of decoding iterations and {Enable parity check output port} sets the parity check status. Values come from the instance.
